problem: Prevailing visual semantic navigation methods extract scene priors from instant observations and store them in neural episodic memory, but forget and underuse these priors, causing repeated exploration, sparse effective knowledge, and wrong decisions.
motivation: A robot navigating to a target object in unseen scenes needs spatial patterns and semantic co-occurrence among objects. Better retention and use of scene priors should reduce redundant exploration and improve decisions, and the policy should also transfer to real settings.
key_idea: Combine an egocentric semantic map (Local Scene Priors) with a commonsense relational graph (Global Scene Priors), using the current local prior to retrieve relevant contextual memories from the global prior inside a DRL navigation policy.
insight: Only the abstract was available, so no ablations can be cited. The abstract claims that hierarchical priors, with local priors retrieving from global ones, address forgetting and underuse of priors and give a significant boost over baselines on MP3D in Habitat.
method: Local Scene Priors (LSP): an egocentric semantic map built from instant observations, which records spatial and semantic layout and reduces repeated exploration.
Global Scene Priors (GSP): a commonsense relational graph of object co-occurrence relations.
LSP-to-GSP retrieval: the immediate LSP is used to retrieve conducive contextual memories from the GSP.
DRL policy: a deep reinforcement learning navigation policy that uses the retrieved priors for decisions.
Habitat-to-ROS migration: the policy is bridged from the Habitat simulator to ROS for real-setting evaluation.

setting.backbone: DRL policy with semantic map encoder and relational graph module (details not given in abstract)
setting.training_data: MP3D dataset in Habitat (details not given in the abstract)
setting.observation: egocentric visual observations (semantic map built from them); exact modalities not stated

results: The abstract states that HSP brings a significant boost over baselines on MP3D in Habitat and that HSPNav generalizes to realistic settings after migration from Habitat to ROS. No numbers are given.
limitations: Only the abstract was available, so the details are unverified.
